subject.title: feat(iOS): Native iOS app — in-chat model/session/agent switcher + Markdown rendering

question: Which in-chat switching controls should native iOS expose, and should they complement or replace the existing sessions and agents navigation?
rationale: The underlying session and model capabilities exist, but iOS deliberately uses separate navigation chrome; selecting the permanent header, drawer, or picker interaction and agent-routing semantics requires product ownership.

options.title: Split focused switchers
options.body: Track model, session, and agent switching as separate focused improvements that reuse existing shared chat capabilities.

options.title: Sponsor one redesign
options.body: Treat all three controls as one coordinated native-chat navigation redesign with an explicit owner and UX specification.

options.title: Keep current navigation
options.body: Retain the current sessions and agents navigation and decline additional in-chat switching controls.

recommendation.title: Split focused switchers
recommendation.body: Track model, session, and agent switching as separate focused improvements that reuse existing shared chat capabilities.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history trail ties this owner to the shared native-chat session switcher and Markdown architecture.
